gitRuns.cancel.description: HI-3372: the button that cancels a commit, set aside, fetch, pull or push while it runs (beside its button, in its dialog, or on its notification while it runs).

gitRuns.stopped.description: HI-3372: a notification's title after the user cancelled a commit, set aside, fetch, pull or push: what was stopped, and what is true now, is said under it.
